statement: Artifacts listed under legacy_artifacts were produced by earlier benchmark scripts in this repository. They are NOT equivalent to the realtask.*.v1 schema family and must never be pooled with it, re-labelled as it, or used to satisfy a real-task qualification requirement. They are retained as historical evidence of what those scripts measured, in the terms those scripts measured it.

rules: Do not add a realtask artifact to a legacy artifact pool, or vice versa.
Do not rename or re-label a legacy artifact with a realtask schema marker.
A qualification claim must cite a realtask.*.v1 artifact and the fixture SHA it names.
When a legacy script is superseded, mark its registry entry superseded and point at the replacement; do not delete the script or its committed artifacts.
